text: Scar didn't make it through the night, chat.
Socks used to sleep right on top of the warm workbench.
We buried Mara out by the pond where she liked to fish.
Nobody came back through the gate after the second expedition.
Pip's bed is still made, and I can't bring myself to remove it.
Day ninety and I just lost the colonist who started this whole run with me.
Moss, you've been here since my very first stream, so this goodbye actually stings.
Rook carved his own grave marker weeks ago, like he knew.
That muffalo pulled every caravan we ever sent out.
It's weirdly quiet in the dining room without Odessa humming.
Juno's expedition timer just ran out and the gate stayed dark.
Last night of this colony, and honestly my chest feels heavy.
Seeing Tamsin's name greyed out in the list hurts more than I expected.
Bram never finished that statue he kept working on.
We lost Ivy to an infection I should have caught sooner.
Hollis is gone, and the workshop just feels empty now.
Wren is heading off tonight after two years of hanging out here.
Socks is buried next to the kitchen door, which feels right.
Saying goodbye to a two hundred day colony is harder than I thought.
My little husky Biscuit didn't survive the cold snap.
We sent four people into that room and only the map came back.
Scar's helmet is sitting on the shelf now, nobody's wearing it.
Mara taught half this colony how to cook.
Okay, I'm gonna need a second before we keep going.
Somehow losing the cat is worse than losing the whole power grid.
Pip was only fifteen in game years, and that's just sad.
Lantern said this is their last stream for a while, and I'm gonna miss them.
Rook's dog keeps lying by his grave every single evening.
Every room in this base has a little bit of Odessa in it.
Final autosave on this colony, I guess.
Juno's chair at the table is still pulled out.
Nova, thank you for every single night you hung out with us.
There's a funeral to plan, so the raid prep can wait an hour.
Tamsin's journal entries just stop on day sixty one.
Bram wanted to see the ocean on the world map, and he never did.
Should have built the hospital closer, honestly.
Note to self, never send anybody alone through a red gate again.
Can't believe I'm tearing up over pixels right now.
Maybe if I'd paused one second earlier.
Just gonna stare at this grave for a minute.
Ugh, I really thought Ivy would pull through that one.
Not deleting her room, not today.
Probably shouldn't have named the chicken.
Do you think Hollis knew how much we needed him?
Is it weird that I miss a muffalo this much?
Can we have a moment of silence for Socks, chat?
Are you really leaving for good, Cobalt?
Should we name the new room after Scar?
Anybody else feel that one in their chest?
Why is it always the sweet ones who go first?
What do we even do with Mara's bow now?
Who's going to tell the kids that Pip is gone?
Where do you want the memorial statue, chat?
It's okay to be sad about a game colonist, Juniper.
Hey, we'll keep her memory going in this base, I promise.
You didn't cause this, Pixel, the dice just rolled badly.
We gave Rook a good life, and that matters.
Take all the time you need, Static Fern, the stream will still be here.
Socks had a long and very spoiled life, so that's something.
Somebody please carry Odessa to the grave gently.
Drop a flower in chat for Bram if you want.
Leave Juno's bedroom exactly as it's, please.
Let's all just sit with this for a second.
Put her favorite hat on the memorial shelf.
Goodbye, Tamsin, you were the best of us!
Rest easy, Biscuit, you very good boy!
Thank you for everything, Wren!
Two hundred days, what a run it's been!
Hollis left a half cooked meal on the stove when the raid hit.
Seeing the empty kennel every morning kind of breaks me a little.
We lost contact with the expedition somewhere past the yellow hallway.
Nobody's sitting in Ivy's spot by the fire tonight.
Clicking end colony feels like turning off a light in a house you loved.
Moss just typed see you around, and that was so soft.
Funeral's done, and the colony is way too quiet.
We've got maybe four days of food left, chat.
Pip's been coughing since yesterday and it's getting worse.
Mara's mood bar is sitting way too close to the red line.
Scouts spotted a big tribal group moving our way.
That gate started glowing purple and nobody touched it.
Rice fields are looking really thin this season.
Odessa hasn't slept in two days and it shows.
There's a weird hum coming from the basement room now.
Rook keeps wandering toward the edge of the map by himself.
A raid letter just arrived, and it says three days.
Juno's infection is climbing faster than her immunity.
Hollis has that stare that usually means a breakdown is coming.
Pantry's down to raw berries and some very questionable kibble.
Something keeps opening the gate at night and closing it again.
Static Fern, you've been really quiet tonight, everything good?
Tamsin's got the flu and a broken leg at the same time.
Bram just yelled at the cat, and he never does that.
Mechanoid cluster landed two tiles from our solar field.
Ivy's been eating without a table for four meals now.
We don't have a single herbal medicine left in storage.
Company sent a memo saying the gate needs inspection, and that's never good.
Lantern mentioned they've had a rough week, so I'm keeping an eye on chat.
Cold snap plus low food is a combination I really don't love.
Scar's mood dropped thirty points from one bad conversation.
Hmm, that's a lot of footprints near the north wall.
Okay, I don't like the color of that gate light.
Need to count the rice again, just to be sure.
Really hoping that's just indigestion and not the plague.
Wait, why is Odessa standing in the freezer?
Gonna watch Mara like a hawk for the next hour.
Pretty sure that hallway was shorter yesterday.
Hold on, let me double check the medicine count.
Is anyone else worried about how quiet the raiders have been?
Did Pip eat anything at all today?
Biscuit, are you doing okay over there?
Should we cancel the expedition until Juno feels better?
Is that gate supposed to be making noise?
Can we even survive another week on this food?
Has anybody seen Rook since breakfast?
Cobalt, did you get some sleep before stream?
How long until Hollis actually snaps, do you think?
What's the safest place to put the sick bed?
Why is the gate counter going backwards?
Where are the raiders going to hit first?
How are you holding up tonight, Nova?
Don't worry, Pip's in bed and the doctor is on it.
We'll ration carefully and we'll be fine, Juniper.
Hey, Wren, no pressure to chat, just glad you're here.
It's alright, Mara just needs a nap and a nice meal.
We've got walls and turrets, so we're not helpless.
Pixel, take care of yourself first, the colony can wait.
Somebody get Tamsin to the hospital bed right now.
Cook simple meals only until the harvest comes in.
Keep everyone away from that gate for tonight.
Draft Bram and send him to his room before he spirals.
Moss, go drink some water, you mentioned a headache.
Stack sandbags along the east wall, quickly.
Oh no, not the food stockpile!
Get away from the gate, Ivy!
That's way too many raiders!
Rook, please don't eat that!
Fever's spreading to a second colonist now.
Trader caravan just cancelled, so no food deal this week.
Hunting is basically dead since the herds left the map.
Odessa's been crying in her room, and the game literally says so.
Mental break risk just changed to major for Scar.
Gate seven opened on its own, and the camera feed went static.
Static Fern said they're feeling kinda low, so let's be nice tonight.
We're one bad harvest away from eating the seed stock.
My doctor is also my only cook, which feels risky.
Snow is coming early and the greenhouse isn't finished.
Scar went down covering the retreat. He bought everyone else enough time to get inside.
Socks is gone, chat. She just curled up by the heater and didn't wake up.
We finally finished Mara's grave. I put a little fence around it so the deer stay out.
Expedition's officially marked lost now. That's three good people the backrooms just kept.
Okay, so Pip didn't make it out of surgery. I really thought the glitterworld medicine would be enough.
Twelve in game years we've had this colony. Tonight's the night we finally let it rest.
Moss just said this is their last stream before moving overseas. I'm honestly gonna miss seeing that name pop up.
Rook's old room is just storage now. Somehow that feels worse than an empty room.
Bram spent his last day teaching Ivy how to sculpt. She's been in the art room ever since.
Our old muffalo finally passed from old age. She hauled every single stone in this base.
Juno's gate signal went dark about ten minutes ago. Company says that usually means she's not coming back.
Hollis wrote a letter before the expedition left. I didn't read it until just now.
Nova's been in this chat for almost every colony I've ever run. Tonight they're saying goodbye for real.
Tamsin's grave is the first one in the new cemetery. I kind of hoped we'd never need it.
Odessa outlived everyone from the original crew. Now it's just her and a lot of headstones.
Biscuit was supposed to be a guard dog. Mostly he just guarded the couch, and I loved him for it.
Last caravan came home without Rook. They brought back his scarf and nothing else.
Ivy kept a little garden by her window. Nobody's watered it since the funeral.
Yeah, I'm ending the colony here. It feels like the right place to stop the story.
We named the bridge after Pip. Every time someone crosses it, the log says his name.
Mara's husband keeps visiting her grave at night. The game didn't have to make that so real.
Wren's been lurking here for two years. She just typed goodbye and thank you, and I'm a little wrecked.
Not gonna lie, I'm a little choked up. Give me a sec.
Should've pulled Scar back sooner. That one's on me.
I keep scrolling past Odessa's portrait. Habit, I guess.
Gonna save one last screenshot of the base. Just for me.
Weird how empty the map feels with one less pawn. Okay, moving on, slowly.
Kept that kitten's bed in the bedroom. Couldn't bring myself to deconstruct it.
Honestly thought we had more time with Bram. Guess not.
Mental note, the pond memorial needs flowers. Lots of flowers.
Pip's gone, chat. Do you guys remember when he was a tiny kid running around the base?
We lost Juno in the gate. Should we keep sending expeditions or just stop for a while?
Juniper, you're really heading out? Will you at least pop in sometimes?
Rook's dog won't eat. Is there anything in the game that helps with that?
Hollis was our only doctor. Can we even keep going without him?
Okay, chat, real question. Do we bury Socks in the garden or by the fireplace?
This is the final day of the colony. Would you all want a last tour of the base?
Tamsin's sister just found out. Is it bad that I paused the game so I wouldn't have to watch?
Cobalt, you've been here since day one. Do you remember what Scar looked like back then?
Our muffalo used to follow Mara everywhere. Does it look lonely to you too?
Bram left his guitar in the rec room. Should we keep it there?
Nobody came out of the gate. Am I a terrible leader for sending them?
Lantern's last stream with us is tonight. Can everyone spam some love for them?
Ivy's grave is right next to her garden. Did I get that right, you think?
I just ended our longest colony ever. Was that the right call?
Odessa keeps visiting the graves. Is she going to be okay?
Pip was so young. Why does the game always do this to me?
We have Scar's rifle now. What do we even do with it?
That expedition was supposed to be easy. How did we lose all three of them?
Pixel, you're leaving for real? Where are you heading?
Our cat is gone, chat. Who's going to sit on my keyboard now?
Okay, we're ending the colony. Which moment was your favorite?
Juno's room is still full of her stuff. When is it okay to clean it out?
Hollis carried this base for years. How do we replace somebody like that?
The gate just closed on Rook's team. How long do we wait before we call it?
Biscuit's collar is in the storage room. Where should we put it?
Mara would've loved this harvest. Why couldn't she hang on one more week?
Hey, Nova, nobody could've saved her. That raid was just too big.
It's okay, we can be sad for a bit. The colony will wait for us.
Juniper, you don't have to apologize for leaving. We're just glad you were here.
Bram went out doing what he loved. That's a good way to go, honestly.
Odessa's going to be alright. She's got Ivy, and Ivy won't leave her side.
Static Fern, it's fine to cry over a game cat. I'm doing it too.
We did everything right with Pip. Sometimes the infection just wins.
You'll always have a seat here, Wren. Come back whenever you want.
Scar's not forgotten, okay? His name's carved on the wall forever.
Breathe, chat. Losing a colony means it mattered to us.
The pets had good lives, I promise. They got fed better than I do.
Somebody bring Mara's dog inside. He shouldn't sit out in the snow.
Put the memorial in the main hall. Everyone should walk past it daily.
Hollis's tools go in his old workshop. Nobody touches them, please.
Type a name in chat for the new statue. We'll carve it for Juno.
Give Odessa the day off. She's grieving and she deserves the rest.
Ivy, go sit with Tamsin for a bit. She shouldn't be alone right now.
Everyone, take one last look at the base. We're closing it after this.
Moss, send us a postcard from the new place. We'll miss you around here.
Scar, you absolute hero, we'll never forget you! Rest well, buddy!
Goodbye, little Socks! You were the softest cat this colony ever had!
Thanks for two whole years, Cobalt! This chat won't be the same!
What a colony, everybody! I'm gonna miss every single one of them!

So I just checked the expedition log, and the last entry from Juno says the hallway keeps going. After that there's nothing, just static. I think we have to accept she's not walking back through that gate.
Mara was the first colonist I ever drafted in this run. She fought off the very first raid with a wooden club and a lot of attitude. Burying her today feels like closing the first chapter of a book.

We're wrapping up the colony tonight after almost three hundred days. I spent the afternoon walking every pawn through their favorite rooms one more time. It's silly, but it felt like the right way to say goodbye.
Biscuit followed Pip everywhere for years, even into the gate room. When Pip passed, Biscuit just stopped eating and slept on his bed. Last night he went too, and honestly that one really got me.

Pixel told me this will be their last stream because life is getting busy. They've been here through four colonies and so many terrible raids. I'm happy for them, but I'm definitely going to feel that empty spot in chat.
Okay, I'm just gonna sit here on the funeral screen for a minute. I know it's a game and I know they're pixels. Still, Hollis felt like a real part of this little family.
We lost Scar during the breach and the base feels so different now. Even the turrets look kind of lonely without him patrolling. Do you think the others can feel it too, or is it just me?

Rook's expedition was supposed to be a quick supply run through the blue rooms. It's been six days and the tether finally snapped this morning. Is there any chance at all that he's still wandering around in there?
Tamsin and Bram were married for most of this colony, and now they're both gone. I put their graves side by side under the big oak tree. What would you all want carved on the stone for them?
Hey, Lantern, I saw your message about missing your old dog tonight. You don't have to be cheerful on my account, okay? We can just hang out quietly and build some furniture together for a while.
I know a lot of you loved Ivy, so this one hurts for everybody. She lived a good long life and she got to see the garden bloom. We'll plant something new there in her honor tomorrow.

Okay, so this is it, chat, the very last day of the Thornfield colony. We started with three broken people in a crashed pod and a bag of rice. Now look at it, all stone walls and gardens and graves of people we loved. I'm really going to miss this place.

Scar's death message just popped up and I genuinely had to stop for a second. He was the one who dragged everyone out of the first gate collapse. He never complained, never broke, just kept carrying people. I don't know who's going to fill those boots.

Socks the cat has been with us since day four, and she passed in her sleep tonight. She was old and comfy and probably very full of stolen fish. Honestly that's the best way out anyone could ask for. Still, the base feels a lot quieter without her.

Moss has been modding this chat for three whole years, and today's their last day. They're starting a new job and won't have evenings free anymore. Every inside joke in this chat has Moss somewhere in its history. Thank you so much, friend, for everything you did here.

We dug the fourth grave this week and I just ran out of good words. Mara, Pip, Bram, and now Odessa, all from one awful winter. I keep thinking about what I could've done differently with the heaters. Let's just give them a quiet minute before we keep playing.

Expedition team two was gone for twenty days, and only the radio came back through the gate. It just plays the same three notes over and over now. I'm keeping it on the shelf in the gate room anyway. It feels like the closest thing to having them home.

Hollis turned eighty today in game, and I knew this day was coming. He was our first doctor and he patched up every single one of us. He went peacefully with Ivy holding his hand in the hospital. I'm not crying, the room is just really dusty.

Note to self, never let a colony get this attached to a single muffalo. Big Bertha carried our caravans across four seasons without one complaint. And now she's gone and I'm looking at an empty barn. Okay, yeah, I'm a little sad about a cow buffalo.

Juno just stepped through the gate to bring back the medicine for the others. The gate shut behind her and the signal went flat. Everybody survived because of what she did in there. Do you think we should name the next colony after her?

We're shutting the colony down after almost a year of streams. I'm proud of it, but closing the save file feels like leaving a home. I made a little highlight reel of all our best moments. Would you want to watch it together before we start something new?

Pip was the kid who grew up on this stream, chat. We watched him go from crawling around the kitchen to running the whole research lab. Tonight the raiders got him, and I'm still kind of numb. How do you even say goodbye to somebody you watched grow up?

Nova just told me this is their goodbye, they're moving and won't have internet for a while. They've been here since I had like four viewers total. I genuinely don't know what streams will feel like without them saying hi. Where do I even start with thanking someone like that?

Hey, chat, I see a lot of you're sad about Tamsin tonight. That's okay, she was everyone's favorite cook and the funniest pawn we had. Feeling it means we cared, and caring is kind of the whole point. We'll get through the funeral together, alright?

Static Fern, I read your message about losing your grandpa recently. I'm really sorry, and you're welcome to just sit here with us tonight. Nobody expects you to chat or be cheerful at all. We'll keep things quiet and cozy while we tend the garden.

I know it feels awful watching Rook's portrait go grey after all that. He made it two hundred days in a world that tried to eat him. That's a good story, and we got to watch every bit of it. He'll stay in our memories as long as this chat does.

Alright, everyone, the funeral is in the main hall in one game hour. Please gather all the colonists and stop the work orders for a bit. Ivy is going to give the eulogy, because she knew Bram best. Let's all show up and send him off properly.

Two hundred and eighty days, chat, and tonight we finally retire this colony. We survived raids, plagues, three gate breaches, and one very angry turkey. I'm so proud of every single colonist who lived here. Thank you for being part of this whole wild journey!
Food stock just dipped under three days. That's cutting it way closer than I like.
Pip's fever jumped again overnight. Doctor says the next twelve hours really matter.
Mara snapped at Rook twice this morning. That's usually how her breaks start.
Scout report says forty raiders camped just off the east edge. They've got mortars too, which isn't great.
Gate three is humming at a pitch I've never heard before. It also started leaking cold air into the hallway.
Our rice crop caught blight this morning. Half the field is already brown.
Odessa's been staring at the wall for an hour. Game says she's dazed, but she looks worse than dazed.
Company headquarters sent a sealed letter marked urgent. Every time they do that something goes sideways.
Juno's leg wound got infected while she was hauling. She really should've been resting.
Hollis keeps skipping meals to finish the turret. He's running on fumes at this point.
Biscuit, you've mentioned work stress like four times tonight. Just wanted to say I noticed.
Snowstorm's rolling in right as our heaters are running low. The timing on this is honestly awful.
That strange room in the basement shifted again. The door is on the other wall now.
Ivy's mood is at fifteen percent. One more bad event and she's going to break.
Mechanoid ship crashed northwest of the base. It's already pinging something every few seconds.
Tamsin hasn't left the medical bed in four days. Her recovery bar barely moved.
Bram's drinking straight from the river now. That's how people end up with gut worms.
Pantry's mostly corn, and corn alone isn't going to keep moods up. People are already complaining.
Gate log shows somebody went through at three in the morning. Nobody in the colony remembers doing it.
Static Fern dropped a message and then went quiet. Hope you're doing alright over there.
Food poisoning is spreading through the kitchen crew. I think the freezer lost power at some point.
Rook's been wandering near the gate during his free time. He keeps saying he hears somebody calling.
Toxic fallout warning just showed up. Our animals are all out in the pasture right now.
Trader didn't have a single bag of rice to sell us. Now the plan's down to hunting.
Medicine shelf is empty except for one herbal pack. That's not enough for two sick people.
Wren's been in chat since six hours ago. That's a long day, friend.
Hmm, that's the third time the gate blinked tonight. Writing that down.
Wait, did that wall just move? No, okay, maybe.
Gonna keep the camera on Mara for a bit. Something's off with her.
Kind of regretting skipping the hydroponics research now. Lesson learned.
Note to self, never let the freezer go unpowered again. Ever.
Pretty sure raiders don't usually wait this long. That's what worries me.
Just gonna quietly count the meals one more time. Yep, still short.
Really hoping that cough is only a cold. Fingers crossed.
Need to stop ignoring that red mood icon. It keeps blinking at me.
Pip still hasn't eaten. Should we force feed him in bed?
Raid letter says five days. Do we have enough steel for more turrets?
Rice is almost gone. Is anyone hunting today, or is everybody busy?
Mara's about to break. Should I give her the day off?
That gate is pulsing faster now. Is it ready to open on its own?
Juniper, you said you weren't feeling great earlier. Are you any better now?
Odessa skipped her last two meals. Did she get the sad mood from the funeral?
Plague is in the base now. Can we quarantine Juno in time?
Our wall still has a gap on the south side. Will it hold if they come early?
Cobalt, you've been up since early this morning. Are you getting any rest tonight?
Hollis keeps muttering about the hallway. Is he cracking up, or did he actually see something?
Corn's ready next week. Can we stretch the food until then?
Ivy's resting in the cold room. Should she be in the hospital instead?
That trader seemed nervous about the gate. Does he know something we don't?
Scar has a tiny scratch that won't heal. Is that a scar or an infection?
Raiders backed off the map edge. Are they regrouping or actually leaving?
Food's almost gone and winter's coming. What do we plant first?
Tamsin's fever is still climbing. How long can she hold out like this?
Gate counter just reset to zero. What does that even mean?
Something keeps knocking on the vault door. Who's out there at this hour?
Nova, you sound tired tonight. How's your week been?
Rook's mood keeps dropping. Why is he so upset all of a sudden?
Raid hits in two days. Where should the killbox go?
Pip coughed blood just now. How bad is that in game terms?
Expedition is overdue by a day. When do we start worrying for real?
Chat's been quiet the last few minutes. How's everybody doing?
Mara's got a catatonic break warning. Which room calms her down the fastest?
Food's tight, but we'll be okay. We've got a muffalo herd if things get desperate.
Pip's in good hands. Hollis has never lost a patient to the flu.
Lantern, you don't need to be okay tonight. Just hang with us.
Raid's coming, but our walls are thick. We've survived worse than this.
Juno's going to pull through. Her immunity's catching up now.
Static Fern, take whatever time you need. We're right here.
Mara just needs a good meal and some sleep. She'll bounce back.
That gate light is creepy, but it's sealed. Nothing's getting through tonight.
We'll ration properly, and nobody's starving on my watch. Promise.
Pixel, it's totally fine to step away. Take care of you first.
Odessa's going to be fine with some rest. I'll keep her off work tomorrow.
Somebody get Pip some medicine. Use the good kind if we've it.
Stop cooking fine meals for now. Simple ones only until the harvest.
Draft everyone and pull them back inside. Raiders are on the edge.
Keep Bram away from the gate room. He's been acting strange.
Biscuit, go grab some water and a snack. Stream will still be here.
Move the sick beds closer to the heater. It's freezing in there.
Seal off the basement hallway tonight. Nobody goes down there alone.
Hunt the deer near the river. We need the meat before the snow.
Raiders are early, everyone inside! Close the gates now!
Ivy is breaking, get her to her room! Quickly, please!
Gate's opening all by itself! Nobody touch it!
Pip just collapsed in the field! Somebody grab him!

Alright, so the food situation is getting serious, chat. We've got about two days of simple meals and the corn won't be ready for six. I'm going to start sending Rook out hunting every morning until things look better.

Mara has been sleeping in the hallway for three nights now, and I think something's wrong. She won't use her bed and her mood keeps sinking. I'm moving her room right next to Ivy's so she isn't alone.

Gate four started making a ticking sound right after midnight in game. Then the lights in the whole east wing flickered at the same time. Nobody's going near that room until I figure out what it's doing.

Funny how quiet the raiders have gone after last week's warning letter. They usually show up within a day of that letter arriving. Honestly, this silence is making me more nervous than an actual raid would.
Hold on, I need to look at Pip's health tab again. His blood loss is still ticking up even after the bandage. That's not supposed to happen, so something else is wrong here.
Juno came back from the expedition with a weird mark on her arm. The game calls it an unknown condition and won't say anything else. Does anyone in chat know what that usually turns into?
Wren, I noticed you mentioned you haven't eaten anything all day. I'm not trying to be your mom or anything, I promise. Could you maybe grab a little something before the next raid hits?

Odessa is hearing voices from the strange room again, and her mood dropped twenty points. I really don't want to lock her out of the lab she loves. What do you all think is the gentlest way to handle this?

I know everybody is worried about Tamsin's infection right now. She's resting in the sterile room and her immunity is actually catching up. Give it one more day, and I really think she'll pull through just fine.
Hey, Juniper, I saw your message about having a rough night at home. You don't have to talk about it unless you want to. We're right here, and this chat is a safe and cozy place for you.

Okay, here's the plan before the raid arrives tomorrow morning. Everyone stockpiles medicine in the hospital and moves the animals inside the walls. Then Bram and Scar man the turrets on the east side, and nobody wanders off alone.

So the company just sent paperwork asking why gate two opened without a work order. Here's the problem, chat, nobody in this colony opened it. The log shows a door cycling at four in the morning with no pawn nearby. I'm putting a guard on that room starting tonight.

Food's officially at the point where I'm doing math every morning. We've got eleven meals for six colonists and a really slow harvest coming. I'm going to cut fancy cooking and stretch everything into simple meals. If we're careful, we might just make it to autumn.

Rook's been showing warning signs for a mental break for two days now. He's skipping his recreation time and keeps getting into arguments with Bram. I really don't want him wandering off into the backrooms mid break. Let's get him some time off and a good meal tonight.

Scouts just reported a pirate camp building up on the southern ridge. They've got at least thirty people and a couple of those big mortars. If they come all at once, our south wall isn't going to hold. We need to start reinforcing it before tomorrow morning.

Cobalt mentioned they've been stuck in the hospital waiting room all evening. I just want you to know you're very welcome to hang out with us. No need to type or keep up with anything going on here. We'll just keep the colony running nice and calm for you.

Pip's flu isn't getting any better, and that's what worries me most. His temperature keeps climbing even with the good medicine. Hollis has been treating him every few hours without a break. I really hope this turns around before the end of the night.

Okay, real quick, I need to talk myself through this gate situation. It opened, a cold wind came out, and then it closed by itself. No sign of anything walking through, and nothing on the motion sensor either. That's either totally fine or a very bad sign.

Bram's mood keeps dropping after the funeral, and he's barely talking to anyone. He hasn't touched his sculpture in three whole days now. Usually art is the thing that pulls him back from a bad stretch. Is there anything we can do to help him before he breaks?

Our only doctor just got sick with the same flu as everyone else. That means nobody's treating Juno or Pip for a full day. I could try training Ivy, but she has zero medical skill. Should we risk it, or is it better to just wait it out?

Lantern, you mentioned earlier that you've had a really heavy week. I don't want to pry or anything, so feel free to ignore me. I just wanted to check in on you before the stream ends. Are you doing alright tonight?

The gate on the third floor started bleeding this weird yellow light into the hallway. Every colonist who walks past it gets a little mood debuff. I've never seen this happen in any of the expeditions before. What do you think it's trying to tell us?
